Title: How do I roll the same number on triple dice?
URL: https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/switch/470862-super-mario-party-jamboree/answers/648422-how-do-i-roll-the-same-number-on-triple-dice
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
1. I got it! Let me show you what I learned if others are having trouble with this achievement too.
Basically, if you have Luigi as a Jamboree buddy, there's a good chance he'll help you get three 10s.
Here are some tips to get you a Luigi and a Triple Dice at the same time:
1. Triple Dice are easier to find in Roll em Raceway, Goomba Lagoon Pro Mode, and Mario's Rainbow Castle. Find em at Koopa Shop.
2. Play against CPUs, wait for a turn where a Jamboree Buddy appears, and if the character isn't Luigi, then save-scum back to the start of that turn to re-roll the Buddy character.
...
2. The easiest method:
Get Luigi as a Jamboree buddy.
Have a triple dice.
Use the triple dice with Luigi. He will swap the role to all 10s. This worked for me immediately.
...
3. There is no cheese, nor anyway to guarantee the roll. However, the board with the most triple dice available is the race track board (Roll 'Em Raceway) so I'd start by playing games against the easiest AI there (or with friends if they need the achievement too). Cheers.
...
4. Hey again, just did the math - it's a 1/10000 (0.01%) chance to roll three of the same number. It might take a while, but good luck.

Title: Mushroom or Double Dice?

Published: N/A

Highlights:
**Double Dice**; adds another die. Costs 5 coins.
-> possible rolls; 2 to 20.
However with the way 2 dice probability works, your most probable roll will be 11; then 10 or 12; then 9 or 13; and so forth.
Why 11? Because it has the most possible combinations on the two 10-dice blocks; 1+10, 2+9, 3+8, 4+7, 5+6, 6+5, 7+4, 8+3, 9+2, and 10+1. Then the numbers closest to 11 go next, and so forth.
...
Also with double dice, if you roll doubles (e.g. 5 + 5) you get 10 coins. However you have a 1in10 chance altogether (10%) of rolling doubles.

With Pro Rules, the Lucky Space has undergone an exciting transformation. You can now choose your reward for landing on a Lucky Space - a Double Dice or 10 coins. Double Dice only cost 5 coins to buy, so you're better off taking the 10 coins and then buying a Double Dice in the shop.
As long as Double Dice isn't sold out yet, the extra coins will always be the better option since you'll get an extra 5 on top of the special dice. Now, you can use your new coins to buy a second item or put them toward a star.
